title: Pass the UF interpretation as one structure; serialize large Lean files
summary: Generated Lean for QF_UF, QF_UFLRA and QF_UFLIA now passes the uninterpreted interpretation as one structure argument, and files above 8 MB elaborate serially. Together they let the 21 MB NEQ004_size4 refutation pass Lean's kernel under the 8 GB memory cap.
